entities.summary: Tyler Biadasz is an American professional football center for the Los Angeles Chargers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Wisconsin Badgers, where he won the Rimington Trophy in 2019. Biadasz was selected by the Dallas Cowboys in the fourth round of the 2020 NFL draft and has also played for the Washington Commanders.
